# Legend Automotive
Legend Automotive is a premium car dealership based in Cairo, Egypt, specializing in luxury and electric vehicles.

## What We Offer
- Electric cars: BYD, and other leading EV brands
- Luxury cars: Mercedes-Benz, and other premium brands
- New and pre-owned vehicles
- Personal consultation service

## Location
Cairo, Egypt
